description: Version 3 whole days, in the lineup-v2.json case shape (see its description). ordering.mode may also be curated. settings may also hold: repeatGapMs and pairUpToMs (decimal strings, ms; given in every curated case, absent elsewhere, where they are not read); weights (title ID to a whole number 1 to 3; absent means every title has weight 1); keeps (series ID to a cap in whole milliseconds, a decimal string; the trim window, applied in every mode as the last step of the epoch's pool); franchises (the franchise map of curated: film ID to collection ID, already resolved); runtimeFilter may also hold episode and movie, each {minMinutes?, maxMinutes?}, the per-kind windows (applied to the epoch's pool, runtimeMs compared to minutes * 60000, both included). Every case has errorTimes S - 1 and E. An inputError case gives no blocks: building the day fails.

cases.name: trim window, a cap over the whole series: k = s, nothing is removed (shuffle)

cases.name: trim window, the first episode is over the cap: k = 1, one episode a day (randomInOrder)

cases.name: trim window, n = -1, two series trimmed, a deleted episode and a short one change s (rotation)
cases.note: The day is n = -1 (S = -86,400,000 on UTC). Episode e[1] (...e9002902) of series ...5e0029 was deleted before the cut-off and the episode ...e9002909 is shorter than minRuntimeMs, so the trim window works on the other six episodes (s = 6; e[] below numbers those six). Series ...5e002b: five 50-minute episodes, cap 120 minutes. series ...5e0029: s = 6, k = 2, start = 4, keeps e[4] e[5]; series ...5e002b: s = 5, k = 2, start = 3, keeps e[3] e[4]. floorMod(-1, s) = s - 1.

cases.note: Series ...5e0029 has seven episodes in the in-group order e[0] to e[6] of 22, 22, 44, 22, 23, 21 and 30 minutes. The episode window (at most 40 minutes) removes e[2] (44 minutes) and series ...5e002a's 44- and 45-minute episodes before the trim window, so the window works on 22, 22, 22, 23, 21, 30 minutes: prefix sums 22, 44, 66, so k = 3 at the cap 3,960,000 ms. series ...5e0029: s = 6, k = 3, start = 3, keeps e[3] e[4] e[5]. Films ...f11700dd and ...f11700de are one franchise (...c0110009).
